title: 第七章 麒麟智械第八章 误闯天家
content_zh:
袁金刚实话实说，是从一个大家千金身上扒下来的。
“这是[麒麟智械]的高订产品，不是量产的，是他们的器道开发者团队限量制作的，整个苍州估计只有几十支。是炼气境界内，最优秀的防御性装备之一，里面甚至有小型的灵能反应堆，可以做到超长续航。”
莫振雄没把话说完。
装备的原主人并不是只买得起这个，而是效力更强的产品，炼气境界就根本承受不住了，强大威力波及到自己，会把自己都给杀掉。
这东西，可以说是为新手保驾护航的断档级别装备。
他诧异的看着袁金刚带来的陌生人，有些担心惹火上身。
“麒麟智械……我真的操了。”
袁金刚当然明白这四个字意味着什么，是21层内器道行业的超级巨头，可以排进前十。
要知道21层可是有三千多个州。
“能搞定么？”
对王庆来说钱是次要，搞不定的话，销毁了就是。
莫振雄沉默不语。
现在是有两个痛点，一个是王庆来路不明，袁金刚这种角色也别指望他有什么品德高尚的朋友，二是这东西确实扎手。
“你们这一行，是按破解难度收工费。这次情况可能不一样，这样吧，如果你还能顺便找到渠道卖出去，你可以直接划20%走。袁金刚，你和另外三人露了面，承担的风险更高，直接划一半走，我要30%就行。还有那双靴子也是一样。”
既然莫振雄说是高端产品，回报可观，王庆暂时也不打算销毁，提价让莫振雄办完这单活儿。
蓝发柜员小妹表情玩味，袁金刚看起来现在是在他手下做事，是这哥们儿在进行决策，处事比姓周的大方多了。
袁金刚当然知道对王庆来说钱不是第一顺位，他想要的是扩张，建立秩序，和上任牢大格局不在一个维度，自然大气。
“那我试试，半个钟头就有结果。”
莫振雄嘴角有些难压，但还是强行绷住，有防弧光防静电的工作间是用来义体改造的，房间另一侧还有着全是精密设备的操作台。
把手表拿到操作台前，这种东西成品全封闭不可拆卸，只有原厂的特殊装置可以进行拆封维修，莫振雄并没有那种技术。

只是将贴片式的数据传输管线摁压在表盘上，用无线传输来对内部数据进行覆写修改。
看莫振雄已经开始干活儿，王庆仔细打量着硬茬接驳中心的环境。
他看不出那些设备专不专业，有一种没有知识的无力感，但各种设施表面上还是比较靠谱的，各种接孔线缆和意义不明的装置挺多，只是卫生情况一般，光线不理想。
是地下街常见的非法改装诊所。
“对了，麒麟智械，有没有那种云数据功能，比如这手表的信息记录，是否会自动上传到他们的网盘里备份。”
王庆很在意这个，那样就太糟了，学校生涯得提前结束，兴许自己得找到他们公司的服务器炸掉。
“不可能，现在的用户很在意信息安全以及是否能被远程控制，东西到手除了维修售后，和出厂公司没有任何关系，哪怕是麒麟智械，为维持市场竞争力，也得遵守这样的规则。”
莫振雄没说完的是，当然也考虑到魔道对器道行业的渗透，灰核城以前发生过政府官员身上的法宝被远程控制自爆的事故，这样的案例并不少。
王庆点了点头，站在莫振雄身后看着他的一举一动。
莫振雄有一个他自己研发自动破解绑定的脚本，对付大多数产品管用，但对付麒麟智械的，他需要修改很多代码来对这个系统进行针对性的骇入。
王庆也只看了大概，根本不懂电脑上那些鬼画符的字母字符代码表示着什么，手表显示屏终于是启动了，但却是蓝屏跳动着一行行数据，莫振雄在不断输入代码优化脚本。
content_en:
Yuan Jingang told the truth that he got it from a rich man.
"This is a high-end product of [Qilin Intelligent Equipment]. It is not mass-produced. It is produced in limited quantities by their Qidao developer team. It is estimated that there are only a few dozen in the entire Cangzhou. It is one of the best defensive equipment in the Qi Refining Realm. It even has a small psychic reactor inside, which can achieve ultra-long battery life."
Mo Zhenxiong didn't finish his words.
The original owner of the equipment was not only able to afford this, but a more powerful product. The Qi Refining Realm simply couldn't bear it. If the powerful power affected him, he would kill himself.
This thing can be said to be a break-level equipment to protect novices.
He looked at the stranger brought by Yuan Jinjiang in surprise, and was a little worried about getting angry.
"Qilin Omnic... I'm really fucked."
Of course Yuan Jingang understands what these four words mean. He is a super giant in the 21st-level inner weapon industry and can be ranked in the top ten.
You must know that there are more than 3,000 states on the 21st floor.
"Can it be done?"
For Wang Qing, money is secondary. If he can't handle it, just destroy it.
Mo Zhenxiong remained silent.
Now there are two pain points. One is that Wang Qing’s background is unknown. For a character like Yuan Jingang, don’t expect him to have any friends with high moral character. The other is that this thing is really painful.
"In your industry, you charge labor fees according to the difficulty of cracking. This time the situation may be different. Let's do it this way. If you can still find a way to sell it, you can just deduct 20%. Yuan Jingang, you and the other three showed up, taking a higher risk. Just deduct half and I will take 30%. The same goes for those boots."
Since Mo Zhenxiong said it was a high-end product with considerable returns, Wang Qing did not intend to destroy it for the time being, and raised the price to let Mo Zhenxiong complete the job.
The blue-haired teller girl had a playful expression on her face. Yuan Jinjiang seemed to be working under him now. It was this guy who was making the decisions and he was much more generous than Zhou.
Of course, Yuan Jingang knew that money was not the first priority for Wang Qing. What he wanted was to expand, establish order, and be natural and grand in a way that was not in the same dimension as his previous position.
"Then I'll give it a try, and I'll have the results in half an hour."
Mo Zhenxiong's mouth was a bit hard to suppress, but he still held it tight. The arc-proof and anti-static workshop was used for prosthetic body modification. On the other side of the room, there was a console full of precision equipment.
Taking the watch to the operating table, the finished product is completely sealed and cannot be disassembled. Only the original factory's special device can be used for unpacking and repair. Mo Zhenxiong does not have that kind of technology.
Just press the patch-type data transmission pipeline on the dial and use wireless transmission to overwrite and modify the internal data.
Seeing that Mo Zhenxiong had already started working, Wang Qing carefully looked at the environment of the hard work connection center.
He couldn't tell whether the equipment was professional or not, and he felt helpless without knowledge. However, the various facilities were relatively reliable on the surface. There were many various jack cables and devices with unknown meanings. However, the hygiene conditions were average and the lighting was not ideal.
It is an illegal modification clinic common in underground streets.
"By the way, Qilin Intelligent Machinery, does it have that kind of cloud data function, such as whether the information records of this watch will be automatically uploaded to their network disk for backup."
Wang Qing was very concerned about this. That would be too bad. His school career would end early, and he might have to find their company's server and blow it up.
"It's impossible. Today's users are very concerned about information security and whether it can be controlled remotely. Apart from maintenance and after-sales service, the items they receive have nothing to do with the factory. Even Kirin smart devices must abide by such rules in order to maintain market competitiveness."
What Mo Zhenxiong didn't finish was that, of course, taking into account the penetration of magic into the weapon industry, there have been many accidents in Gray Core City where government officials' magic weapons were remotely controlled to self-destruct.
Wang Qing nodded, standing behind Mo Zhenxiong and watching his every move.
Mo Zhenxiong has a script he developed himself to automatically crack bindings, which works for most products, but to deal with the Kirin Omnic, he needs to modify a lot of code to hack the system in a targeted manner.
Wang Qing only took a rough look and had no idea what the ghostly character codes on the computer meant. The watch display finally started up, but the blue screen was jumping with rows of data. Mo Zhenxiong was constantly inputting code optimization scripts.
